page.title: Components
page.lead: The core fundamentals and compounds in HeroUI v3's look and feel, on one scrollable page: grouped into fundamentals and compounds under HeroUI v3's own categories, showing capsule controls, soft surfaces, sizes and interactive states.

groups.title: Fundamentals
groups.intro: Single controls and display primitives built directly on design tokens.

categories.title: Buttons
categories.intro: Capsule triggers, attached groups and segmented choices.

examples.title: Button
examples.description: Primary electric blue for the main action, strong ink for high-contrast calls, outline and ghost for quieter tools, danger for destructive steps.

examples.title: Button sizes
examples.description: Large (40 px), medium default (36 px), small (32 px) and compact (28 px), alongside icon-leading, icon-only and pending states.

examples.title: Button group
examples.description: Related actions joined into one capsule with shared inner edges.

examples.title: Toggle button group
examples.description: Mutually exclusive views inside a soft pill track with a raised indicator.

categories.title: Forms
categories.intro: Fields and choice groups for structured input.

examples.title: Text field and search field
examples.description: Rounded 12 px fields on a crisp surface, with a leading search icon and clear action when filtering.

examples.title: Field states
examples.description: Disabled input and inline validation feedback that preserves what was typed.

examples.title: Number field
examples.description: Tabular numeric entry with steppers and drag-to-scrub label.

examples.title: Text area
examples.description: Multi-line notes that scroll cleanly with the library bar.

examples.title: Checkbox group
examples.description: Checked, unchecked, mixed and disabled boxes grouped under one legend.

examples.title: Radio group
examples.description: One choice from a short visible set.

categories.title: Pickers
categories.intro: Choosing from a list or narrowing a long set by typing.

examples.title: Select
examples.description: Single-choice combobox across HeroUI v3's size scale, opening a concentric rounded listbox.

examples.title: Combo box
examples.description: Type to filter a longer list of destinations with keyboard navigation.

examples.title: Switch
examples.description: Solid neutral track when off and electric blue when on, with a crisp white thumb.

examples.title: Slider
examples.description: Single value and dual-thumb range tracks.

categories.title: Date and Time
categories.intro: Typed segments and calendar grids for scheduling.

examples.title: Date picker
examples.description: Segmented date input paired with a popover month grid.

examples.title: Date and time fields
examples.description: Arrow-key spinbutton segments for dates and clock times.

examples.title: Calendar
examples.description: Standalone month view for picking a day directly.

categories.title: Collections
categories.intro: Action menus and removable tag sets.

examples.title: Dropdown
examples.description: Capsule menu triggers across every size, opening a floating menu with icons, shortcuts and a separated danger row.

examples.title: Tag group
examples.description: Soft pill tags for toggling filters and removing chosen topics.

categories.title: Media, Typography and Colors
categories.intro: People, status pills, keyboard hints and colour selection.

examples.title: Avatar and avatar group
examples.description: Circular and rounded-square avatars with presence and an overflow count.

examples.title: Chip and badge
examples.description: Solid and soft capsule pills, status dots and numeric counters.

examples.title: Kbd and typography
examples.description: Keyboard shortcut keys, display headings, body copy and underlined links.

examples.title: Color picker
examples.description: Saturation area, hue bar, channel fields and quick swatches.

groups.title: Compounds
groups.intro: Larger surfaces, navigation patterns and overlays composed from fundamentals.

categories.title: Feedback
categories.intro: Inline notices, determinate progress and loading placeholders.

examples.title: Alert
examples.description: Rounded surface callouts for info, success, warning and recoverable errors.

examples.title: Progress bar and spinner
examples.description: Determinate bars with percentage readout and an inline turning arc.

examples.title: Skeleton
examples.description: Shimmering placeholders matching avatar and text geometry while content arrives.

categories.title: Navigation
categories.intro: Switching views, folding sections and moving across pages.

examples.title: Tabs
examples.description: Secondary underline tabs and vertical side tabs.

examples.title: Accordion
examples.description: Collapsible questions separated by hairline rules.

examples.title: Breadcrumbs and pagination
examples.description: Location trail above the view and capsule page buttons below a list.

categories.title: Overlays
categories.intro: Floating dialogs, drawers, popovers, tooltips and toasts.

examples.title: Modal and alert dialog
examples.description: Centred 24 px surface dialog for a focused form or destructive confirmation.

examples.title: Drawer
examples.description: Edge sheet for live workspace preferences.

examples.title: Popover and tooltip
examples.description: Anchored mini-form popover and compact hover hint.

examples.title: Toast
examples.description: Bottom notification pills that auto-dismiss for updates and stay for errors.

categories.title: Data Display and Layout
categories.intro: Structured records, surface cards and empty containers.

examples.title: Table
examples.description: Rows of members with avatars, roles, status chips and amounts.

examples.title: Card
examples.description: Pure white 24 px surface card over the soft neutral canvas.

examples.title: Empty state
examples.description: Clear explanation and first action inside an empty region.

words.q1: How does HeroUI v3 handle dark mode?
words.a1: Semantic surface and foreground tokens swap cleanly between light and dark schemes without component overrides.
words.q2: Can components be used with keyboard navigation?
words.a2: Every picker, menu, dialog and tab list follows WAI-ARIA keyboard patterns with a visible focus ring.
words.q3: Why are buttons shaped as capsules?
words.a3: Full-pill triggers contrast with 12 px fields and 24 px cards so interactive actions stand out immediately.
